DE.claim: The blue comet was projected onto the planetarium dome at some time during the scene-four rehearsal.
DE.evidence_criterion: Use the sentence excluding projection from the opening bell through the closing cue and the blank dome through the end bell. Both intervals together cover the rehearsal.

closing.quote: At the closing cue the house lights came up on a blank dome. It stayed blank while Kit rang the bell to end the rehearsal.

middle.quote: The two women worked through the middle pages in the hush between the fan and the ticking clock. By the time Kit got back to the desk the tea had a skin on it. Ada held the chipped cup for her while she wrote the final cue in her own hand.

retrospective.quote: From Kit's opening bell to the closing cue, no projection of the blue comet appeared anywhere on the dome.

slide.quote: On the console lay the blue comet slide in its cardboard mount. A boy had drawn the tail with a scratched needle forty years ago. Ada could feel the burr when she ran a thumb along the edge. On the running sheet the cue had a square beside it for a tick. Someone had sharpened a pencil and left the shavings in the square.
